summary: Forge maintenance selection excludes the currently executing issue, controller self-selection, PM-review handoff states, already processed issues, active owners, protected dependency issue 69, and previously processed issues whose HEAD SHA has not changed. Maintenance passes now emit processed/skipped summary evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Never reclaim the issue currently executing.
evidence: tests/forge-trigger.test.mjs: maintenance classification skips the currently executing issue even without owner labels

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Persist processed-this-cycle list and prevent same-cycle duplicate execution.
evidence: tests/forge-trigger.test.mjs: maintenance restart cooldown prevents duplicate claim comments and execution commits

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Skip issues whose HEAD commit has not changed.
evidence: tests/forge-trigger.test.mjs: maintenance classification skips previously processed issue when HEAD is unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: After execution_completed, issue becomes ineligible until PM changes state.
evidence: hasVerifiedForgeSubmission requires terminal forge labels plus pm:review
tests/forge-trigger.test.mjs: maintenance selection skips controller and PM-review handoff states

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Skip forge:done + pm:review and forge:blocked + pm:review.
evidence: tests/forge-trigger.test.mjs: maintenance selection skips controller and PM-review handoff states

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Never allow the maintenance issue to process itself.
Log every skip reason and produce processed/skipped summary.
evidence: tests/forge-trigger.test.mjs: maintenance poller reports processed and skipped issue summary

validation.targetedRed: node --test tests/forge-trigger.test.mjs: failed before implementation for currently_executing, head_unchanged, and maintenance_summary expectations
validation.diffCheck: git diff --check: exit 0 with line-ending warnings only
